Karthik —

We started seeing a token-level latency increase and intermittent 5xx errors against the inference endpoint for our checkout flow at ~08:20 PDT this morning. I've attached a short capture from our side (qos-metrics-20270411.csv) and a quick video of the checkout hang.

Thanks,
Ethan

Subject: RE: Increased 5xxs + token latency spike this morning

Folks —

Root cause (initial): autoscaler triggered a scale-down during a low-traffic window; a small subset of long-lived KV-cache sessions were remapped to newly provisioned workers that had a slightly different kernel selection for the quantized runtime. That combination created higher warmup token costs + intermittent memory pressure, which showed up as latency spikes and transient 5xxs for affected routes.

Immediate mitigations applied:
- Disabled aggressive scale-down policy for the affected Dedicated pool (now on hold).
- Forced rollover of impacted KV sessions to stable workers.
- Added a short-lived routing rule to send Copperlane traffic to the warm pool during promo hours.

I'm drafting a formal RCA doc (will attach). Preliminary impact window 08:19–08:36 PDT, peak error rate 4.6% on checkout route.

Kimberly
Senior SRE, Redwood Inference

Attachments: copperlane-rca-draft.txt (internal draft)

Attached is the formal RCA (copperlane-rca-v1.pdf) and the mitigation checklist with owner assignments (mitigation-checklist-v2.xlsx). Highlights:
- Cause: autoscaler scale-down + kernel deviation for quantized runtime on rolled workers => warmup token penalty + transient memory pressure => 502/503s.
- Scope: 08:19–08:36 PDT on 2027-04-11. Peak error rate 4.6% on checkout route; sustained latency increase for median token time from 28ms to 110ms during peak.
- Immediate fixes already applied: autoscaler policy conservative mode, warm pool pinning, forced KV session rebalancing.

Action items (short list):
1) Ops: bake a warm-pool pin toggle per account for promo windows (owner: Grace) — target: 2027-04-16
2) Runtime: add kernel-selection consistency checks on worker join (owner: Jonas) — target: 2027-05-01
3) Billing: SLA review with procurement for crediting assessment (owner: Karthik) — target: 2027-04-18

Please review the attachments and confirm when you'd like a recording for your execs. We can also run a short postmortem walkthrough next Thursday if that helps.

Karthik
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
